# Mod packs (generated by `cargo xtask format-docs`; do not edit)

Files: `mod.ron` ([ModFile](#modfile)), `weapons/<id>.ron` ([Weapon](#weapon)), `projectiles/<id>.ron` ([Projectile](#projectile)), `editor/mod.ron` ([ModEditorFile](#modeditorfile)), [`restrictions.ron`](#restrictions-ron), `gfx/<file>.png`, `gfx/<file>.glow.png`, `sfx/<file>`.

The mod authoring format (spec §2): `mod.ron`, `weapons/<id>.ron`, `projectiles/<id>.ron` (shared projectiles) and `restrictions.ron`.

The assets beside them: images in `gfx/` (PNG with alpha, a strip of square frames: frame count = width ÷ height, the only thing about an image the simulation reads) and sounds in `sfx/` (WAV or Ogg Vorbis). An image `gfx/<name>.png` may have a glow mask, `gfx/<name>.glow.png` (issue #19): an 8-bit greyscale PNG of the image's size, 0 no glow to 255 full, drawn in the nearest quarter (below 32 none, 224 and above full). A glowing pixel shows bright whatever a level's darkness, in its own colour; a projectile's `look.glow` still brightens its whole sprite. A mask without its image, or of another size, is an error.

<a id="restrictions-ron"></a>

## `restrictions.ron`

The mod's weapon-restriction presets by name (OLX's `.wps` files), optional; the game's default is `Standard 100lt`.

Type: map of name → [Preset](#preset).

Example:

```ron
{
    "Standard 100lt": {
        "Bazooka": Enabled,
    },
}
```

<a id="modfile"></a>

## ModFile (`mod.ron`)

`mod.ron`: the mod's name, physics and weapon list (OLX `script.lgs`'s header and `gs_worm_t`, `CGameScript.cpp`).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Shown in menus; bot loadouts and weapon restrictions match on it (OLX: the lgs header's `ModName`, `CGameScript.cpp`, header bytes 24..88). |
| `notes` | string | `""` | Free text for authors; ignored by the game. |
| `worm` | [Worm](#worm) | each field's default | Worm physics (`mod-fields.md` §3). |
| `rope` | [Rope](#rope) | `(max_length: 300, rest_length: 30, strength: 3.5)` | Ninja rope (`mod-fields.md` §4). |
| `weapons` | list of string | required | The weapon ids, in order: `weapons/<id>.ron` each; a weapon's index is its id in the game. At most `MAX_WEAPONS` (512). |
| `loadouts` | map of name → [ShippedLoadout](#shippedloadout) | `{}` | The mod's shipped loadouts (read-only in the game; every mod also has `Default`, every weapon at 100 %), each keyed by the name of a preset of `restrictions.ron`: the weapons that preset enables (Bonus and Banned off), at its loading time. Not an OLX field: OLX set `LoadingTime` apart from the preset. At most `MAX_LOADOUTS` (64). |
| `look` | [ModWideLookSource](#modwidelooksource) (optional) | none | The mod's look as a whole: the explosion light and heat of every projectile without its own. Presentation only. Default none. |

Example:

```ron
(
    name: "Rocket Mod",
    notes: "One weapon, to start from.",
    worm: (
        gravity: 100.0,
        jump_speed: -65.0,
    ),
    weapons: [
        "bazooka",
    ],
)
```

<a id="weapon"></a>

## Weapon (`weapons/<id>.ron`)

`weapons/<id>.ron` (OLX `weapon_t`, `include/WeaponDesc.h:90-121`).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Shown in menus; restrictions and bot loadouts match on it (OLX `name`). |
| `notes` | string | `""` | Free text for authors; ignored by the game. |
| `recharge` | number | required | Full magazines per second at LoadingTime 100 % (OLX stores the file's value ÷ 10, `CGameScript.cpp:777`; this is that value). |
| `drain` | number | required | Percent of a full magazine used per shot (> 100 empties it) (OLX `drain`, `CServer_Game.cpp:395-410`). |
| `between_shots_s` | number | required | Seconds between shots (OLX's `ROF` ÷ 1000, `CGameScript.cpp:776`). |
| `laser_sight` | boolean | `false` | Spawns a laser-sight entity every sub-step while the weapon is not reloading; the entity takes an entity-pool slot, so it counts in the simulation (OLX `CClient_Game.cpp:751-808`). |
| `fire` | [Fire](#fire) | required | What a shot does (OLX `Wpn_Type` and its payload, `mod-fields.md` §5). |
| `look` | [WeaponLookSource](#weaponlooksource) (optional) | none | The weapon's look (look system): its muzzle light. Default none. |

Example:

```ron
(
    name: "Bazooka",
    recharge: 0.171,
    drain: 33.334,
    between_shots_s: 1.071,
    fire: Projectile(
        recoil: 15,
        sound: "sfx/bazooka.ogg",
        shot: (
            speed: 140,
            projectile: (
                gfx: Image(
                    file: "gfx/missile.png",
                    frames_follow_heading: true,
                    heading_frames: 18,
                ),
                gravity: 0,
                velocity_factor: 1.001,
                trail: Smoke,
                hit_terrain: [
                    Explode(
                        damage: 4,
                        shake: 2,
                        sound: "sfx/exp2.ogg",
                    ),
                    Spawn("spawn"),
                ],
                hit_worm: [
                    Explode(
                        damage: 27,
                    ),
                    Spawn("spawn"),
                ],
                spawns: {
                    "spawn": (
                        amount: 12,
                        speed: 105,
                        speed_var: 14.0,
                        spread: 360.0,
                        shared: "shrapnel",
                    ),
                },
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
```

<a id="projectile"></a>

## Projectile (`projectiles/<id>.ron`)

A projectile (OLX `proj_t`, `include/ProjectileDesc.h:80-121`), inline in a spawn or in `projectiles/<id>.ron` (shared); at most `MAX_SHARED` (4096) shared ones.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (optional) | none | The runtime id, written only when it differs from the one derived from its place (`<weapon id>`, then `.spawn` / `.trail` per level). Never set in `projectiles/` files (their id is the file name). |
| `notes` | string | `""` | Free text for authors; ignored by the game. |
| `gfx` | [Gfx](#gfx) | required | Simulation data, not only looks: the colour count, rotation and animation affect play (`mod-fields.md` §1.2, §8). |
| `size` | (integer, integer) (optional) | none | Collision box in px (OLX `width`, `height`; radius = half). Default (2, 2) for `Pixels`, (4, 4) for `Image` (`CGameScript.cpp:873-878`). |
| `gravity` | integer (optional) | none | px/s² added to the vertical velocity (OLX `ProjGravity`); absent = the world's gravity (100). `0` and `100` are written: they are not "absent" (`mod-fields.md` §1.4). |
| `velocity_factor` | number | `1.0` | Velocity × this once per 11 ms physics step (> 1 accelerates). OLX's `Dampening`. |
| `timer` | [Timer](#timer) (optional) | none | The timed event (OLX `Timer`); absent = none. |
| `trail` | [Trail](#trail) | `Off` | What the projectile leaves behind while flying (OLX `Trail`, `mod-fields.md` §11). |
| `hit_terrain` | list of [Effect](#effect) | `[]` | When the projectile hits rock or dirt (OLX `Hit`). `[]` = OLX's `Nothing`. The effect kind also selects the collision physics: `Bounce`, `Nothing` (half-move), `GoThrough` (no stop), `Explode` in dirt only (keeps position); everything else stops at the last safe position (`mod-fields.md` §7). At most `MAX_EFFECTS` (16). |
| `hit_worm` | list of [Effect](#effect) | `[]` | When it hits a worm (OLX `PlayerHit`). `[]` = `Nothing`, which also turns worm collision off; `GoThrough` hits but does not stop. At most `MAX_EFFECTS` (16). |
| `spawns` | map of name → [EventSpawn](#spawn) | `{}` | Named spawns that `Spawn(<name>)` effects use. This runtime takes at most one, shared by all events (OLX `GeneralSpawnInfo`, expanded as `<path>.spawn`). |
| `look` | [ProjectileLookSource](#projectilelooksource) (optional) | none | The projectile's look (look system): glow, a light, an end flash, its explosions' light and heat, its heat a tick; presentation only. Default none. |

Example:

```ron
(
    gfx: Pixels([
        "#b0b0b0",
    ]),
    gravity: 70,
    hit_terrain: [
        Explode(
            damage: 2,
            shake: 1,
        ),
    ],
    hit_worm: [
        Injure(
            damage: 2,
        ),
    ],
)
```

<a id="modeditorfile"></a>

## ModEditorFile (`editor/mod.ron`)

What the mod editor remembers of a mod: the mod it was copied from, whose values it shows beside the fields that differ (Original, Reset).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base` | string (optional) | none | The pack id of the mod this one was copied from (`olx-classic`); none for a mod made otherwise. The manifest's `origin` says where a pack was imported from, so a copy clears it: this keeps the editor's own reference. |

Example:

```ron
(
    base: "olx-classic",
)
```

<a id="preset"></a>

## Preset

One `.wps` file as `CWpnRest::loadList` holds it: weapon name to state. OLX keys its map ignoring ASCII case, keeps a name's first spelling and the state of its last line; names are not trimmed when stored.

Type: map of name → [WeaponState](#weaponstate).

<a id="worm"></a>

## Worm

Worm physics of the mod (OLX `gs_worm_t`, `CGameScript.cpp:45-55`). Defaults are OLX's FeatureList values (`FeatureList.cpp:67-71`).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ground_acceleration` | number | `8.0` | × 90 px/s² while walking on the ground, until the max ground speed (OLX `ground_speed`; FeatureList `WormGroundSpeed`). |
| `air_acceleration` | number | `4.0` | × 90 px/s² while moving in the air, up to the max air speed (OLX `air_speed`; FeatureList `WormAirSpeed`). |
| `gravity` | number | `50.0` | px/s² added to the vertical velocity (OLX `gravity`; FeatureList `WormGravity`). |
| `jump_speed` | number | `-75.0` | px/s, negative = up: a ground jump sets the vertical speed to it (OLX `jump_force`; FeatureList `WormJumpForce`). |
| `air_drag` | number | `0.0` | Quadratic drag in the air, 1/px (OLX `air_friction`; FeatureList `WormAirFriction`). |
| `unused_angle_speed` | number | `150.0` | Unit: none (would be deg/s). Ignored by OLX ("was always ignored", `CGameScript.cpp:45`); kept for losslessness. |
| `unused_ground_friction` | number | `0.4` | Unit: none. Ignored by OLX (`CGameScript.cpp:53`); kept for losslessness. |

<a id="rope"></a>

## Rope

Ninja rope of the mod (`CGameScript.cpp:787-800`).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_length` | integer | `300` | px: a flying hook farther than this stops and falls (FeatureList `RopeMaxLength`; OLX `CNinjaRope.cpp`). |
| `rest_length` | integer | `30` | px: no pull while the worm is closer (FeatureList `RopeRestLength`). |
| `strength` | number | `3.5` | × 100 px/s² toward the hook (FeatureList `RopeStrength`). |

<a id="shippedloadout"></a>

## ShippedLoadout

A shipped loadout as a mod pack lists it in `mod.ron`'s `loadouts`, keyed by the name of the preset whose weapons it enables (issue #5, not an OLX setting; the game's side is `olr_data::loadouts`).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `loading_time` | integer | required | Percent, 0 to 500 (OLX's `LoadingTime` range, `src/common/FeatureList.cpp:31`): weapons reload in `100 / loading_time` times their time. |
| `unique` | boolean | `false` | A worm's slots must hold different weapons. |

<a id="modwidelooksource"></a>

## ModWideLookSource

A mod's look as a whole (`mod.ron`'s `look`).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `explosion` | [ExplosionLightSource](#explosionlightsource) (optional) | none | The explosion light of every projectile without its own `explosion`. Default none: the engine's. |
| `explosion_heat` | [ExplosionHeatSource](#explosionheatsource) (optional) | none | The explosion heat of every projectile without its own `explosion_heat`. Default none: the engine's. |

<a id="fire"></a>

## Fire (enum)

How a weapon fires (OLX `Wpn_Type`; `docs/porting/olx-notes/mod-fields.md` §5).

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Projectile` | `class`, `recoil`, `sound`, `shot` | `WPN_PROJECTILE`: the shot spawns projectiles. |
| `Beam` | `recoil`, `colour`, `hole_size`, `worm_damage`, `length`, `width`, `width_growth`, `split_damage_over_width` | `WPN_BEAM` (`include/WeaponDesc.h:71-85`): an instant trace. |
| `Special` | `kind`, `thrust` | `WPN_SPECIAL`: a special device such as a jetpack. |

### `Fire::Projectile`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `class` | [WeaponClass](#weaponclass) | `Automatic` | Unused by OLX and the bots; kept for the record (`CGameScript.cpp:729`). |
| `recoil` | integer | `0` | px/s velocity impulse against the aim, once per shot (OLX `CClient_Game.cpp:909-914`); bots read a negative value as a jetpack. |
| `sound` | string (optional) | none | Pack path of the firing sound, played at the shot position (OLX `sound`). |
| `shot` | [ShotSpawn](#spawn) | required | What the shot spawns (OLX `Proj_SpawnInfo` of the weapon; shot context). |

### `Fire::Beam`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recoil` | integer | `0` | px/s; unused by the simulation (bots read its sign) (OLX `recoil`). |
| `colour` | [colour](#colour) | required | `#rrggbb`. The beam is not drawn when it is `#ff00ff` (OLX `colour`). |
| `hole_size` | integer | `0` | Hole size carved at the first dirt or rock pixel (0..4); -1 = none (OLX `damage`). |
| `worm_damage` | integer | `0` | Health points to the first other worm within 5 px of the trace (OLX `player_damage`). |
| `length` | integer | `0` | Maximum trace length in px (one step = 1 px along the aim) (OLX `length`). |
| `width` | integer | `1` | Parts side by side at the start, px. Default 1 (OLX `init_width`). |
| `width_growth` | number | `0.0` | px of width added per px of length (OLX `width_increase`). |
| `split_damage_over_width` | boolean | `false` | Divides both damages over the beam's width (at least 1 per part) (OLX `distribute_damage_over_width`). |

### `Fire::Special`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | [SpecialKind](#specialkind) | required | Which special (OLX `Wpn_Special`). |
| `thrust` | integer | required | Jetpack: value × 50 px/s² upward per 10 ms frame (OLX `CClient_Game.cpp:549-585`). |

## WeaponLookSource

A mod weapon's look.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `muzzle_light` | [LightSource](#lightsource) (optional) | none | Replaces the engine's muzzle-flash light. Default none. |

<a id="gfx"></a>

## Gfx (enum)

How a projectile looks (and what it costs the simulation); OLX `ProjectileGfx`, `mod-fields.md` §8.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Pixels` | list of [colour](#colour) | A 1 px square. One of the `#rrggbb` colours is drawn at spawn (one `rand()`; none when the list is empty). OLX `Pixel.colours`. At most `MAX_COLOURS` (256). |
| `Image` | `file`, `rotating`, `rotation_step_deg`, `rotation_speed`, `frames_follow_heading`, `frames_follow_heading_mirrored`, `heading_frames`, `animation` | An image strip (OLX `Image`). |

### `Gfx::Image`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string | required | Pack path of the image strip. Frames are square: frame count = width ÷ height (`mod-fields.md` §8). |
| `rotating` | boolean | `false` | Spins at `rotation_speed` and gets a random start rotation when a shot spawns it (OLX `Rotating`). |
| `rotation_step_deg` | integer | `0` | Degrees per image frame; the random start rotation's step (OLX `rot_increment`). |
| `rotation_speed` | integer | `0` | Degrees per second while `rotating` (OLX `rot_speed`). |
| `frames_follow_heading` | boolean | `false` | Render only: the frame follows the heading (OLX `use_angle`). |
| `frames_follow_heading_mirrored` | boolean | `false` | Render only: left- and right-moving halves over 151° (OLX `use_spec_angle`). |
| `heading_frames` | integer | `0` | Render only: number of frames the two heading schemes use (OLX `angle_images`). |
| `animation` | [Animation](#animation) (optional) | none | Frame animation (OLX `Animating`); absent = static. |

<a id="timer"></a>

## Timer

OLX `Proj_LX56Timer` (`ProjAction.h:452-468`). It fires every step once its time has passed.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `after_s` | number | required | Seconds of projectile life (OLX `time`). The effects need `after_s > 0`. |
| `variation_s` | number | `0.0` | Seconds, ± range (× the projectile's fixed random in [-1, 1]; OLX `time_var`). |
| `effects` | list of [Effect](#effect) | `[]` | What fires. `[]` = `Nothing`, which also cancels a spawn on a timer (OLX `action`; at most `MAX_EFFECTS` (16)). |

<a id="trail"></a>

## Trail (enum)

OLX `Proj_Trail` (`ProjAction.h:131-138`).

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Off` | — | `TRL_NONE`: no trail. |
| `Smoke` | — | A smoke entity every 75 ms (OLX trail type 1). |
| `ChemSmoke` | — | A chemical-smoke entity every 75 ms (OLX trail type 2). |
| `Doomsday` | — | A doomsday entity every 50 ms (OLX trail type 4). |
| `Explosive` | — | A cosmetic explosion entity (size 10) every 50 ms (OLX trail type 5). |
| `Projectile` | `every_s`, `spawn` | A spawn every `every_s` seconds (whole ms), the first on the first step (OLX trail type 3). |
| `Unknown` | integer | An OLX trail type this format has no name for: no trail. |

### `Trail::Projectile`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `every_s` | number | `0.1` | Seconds between spawns (OLX `delay`). Default 0.1. |
| `spawn` | [TrailSpawn](#spawn) | required | What each trail step spawns (OLX `spawn`; trail context). |

<a id="effect"></a>

## Effect (enum)

What an event does (OLX `Proj_ActionType`, `include/ProjAction.h:147-175`; `mod-fields.md` §12). An event's list holds at most one effect besides `Spawn` in this runtime.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Explode` | `damage`, `shake`, `sound` | A blast, then the projectile dies. |
| `Bounce` | `factor`, `explode` | Bounces off terrain or a worm; `explode` > 0 blasts too. |
| `Injure` | `damage` | On a worm: injures, then the projectile dies. On terrain it behaves like `Halt`: it stops and dies only at the map border. |
| `Carve` | `size` | A hole at once (before the move on a timer), then the projectile dies. Against a worm it only pushes. |
| `Dirt` | `shake` | Three dirt balls, then the projectile dies. |
| `GreenDirt` | `shake` | Green dirt, then the projectile dies. |
| `Halt` | — | OLX's `Disappear` (7), renamed for what it does: mostly ignored in LX56, the projectile stops but is **not** removed (it dies only at the map border); on a worm it only pushes. `Remove` removes it. |
| `Remove` | — | OLX's `Disappear2` (9): the projectile dies. |
| `GoThrough` | — | Passes through terrain (`hit_terrain`) or worms (`hit_worm`). |
| `InjureProjectile` | — | No effect in LX56 events (no targets). |
| `Sound` | `file` | Plays a sound (OLX `PlaySound`; LX56 files never set one). |
| `InjureWorm` | `damage` | On a worm: injures; the projectile keeps flying. |
| `ChangeRadius` | — | OLX `ChangeRadius`: a no-op in LX56. |
| `SetSpeed` | — | OLX `OverwriteOwnSpeed`: sets the velocity to (0, 0) in LX56. |
| `MultiplySpeed` | — | OLX `MultiplyOwnSpeed`: a no-op in LX56. |
| `AddSpeed` | — | OLX `DiffOwnSpeed`: a no-op in LX56. |
| `SetTargetSpeed` | — | OLX `OverwriteTargetSpeed`: no targets in LX56, nothing. |
| `MultiplyTargetSpeed` | — | OLX `MultiplyTargetSpeed`: no targets, nothing. |
| `AddTargetSpeed` | — | OLX `DiffTargetSpeed`: no targets, nothing. |
| `HomeOnNearestWorm` | — | OLX `HeadingToNextWorm`: steers toward the nearest living worm. |
| `HomeOnOwner` | — | OLX `HeadingToOwner`: steers toward the owner. |
| `HomeOnNearestOtherWorm` | — | OLX `HeadingToNextOtherWorm`: steers toward the nearest worm that is not the owner. |
| `HomeOnNearestEnemy` | — | OLX `HeadingToNextEnemyWorm`: as `HomeOnNearestOtherWorm` without teams. |
| `HomeOnNearestTeamMate` | — | OLX `HeadingToNextTeamMate`: a no-op without teams. |
| `PullTargetsToUs` | — | OLX `HeadTargetToUs`: no targets, nothing. |
| `Unknown` | integer | An OLX action number this format has no name for: nothing, but the worm push still applies. |
| `Spawn` | string | Spawns the named entry of the projectile's `spawns`. |

### `Effect::Explode`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `damage` | integer | `0` | Health points to every living worm within 5 px (no falloff) and the hole size `clamp(damage, 0, 4)`; -1 = no blast (still dies and spawns) (OLX `damage`). |
| `shake` | integer | `0` | World px of camera shake (cosmetic, ±shake for 200 ms) (OLX `shake`). |
| `sound` | string (optional) | none | Pack path of the explosion sound, played at the position (OLX `sound`). |

### `Effect::Bounce`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `factor` | number | `0.5` | Unitless velocity factor on the colliding side (OLX `bounce_coeff`). Default 0.5. |
| `explode` | integer | `0` | Blast damage on every colliding step (health points and hole size, as `Explode`); 0 = none. Not on a timer (OLX `bounce_explode`). |

### `Effect::Injure`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `damage` | integer | `0` | Health points (OLX `damage`). |

### `Effect::Carve`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | integer | `0` | Hole size, 0 to 4 (OLX `damage`). |

### `Effect::Dirt`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shake` | integer | `0` | World px of camera shake; applies on a timer only (OLX `shake`). |

### `Effect::GreenDirt`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shake` | integer | `0` | World px of camera shake; applies on a timer only (OLX `shake`). |

### `Effect::Sound`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string (optional) | none | Pack path of the sound (OLX `sound`). |

### `Effect::InjureWorm`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `damage` | integer | `0` | Health points (OLX `damage`). |

<a id="spawn"></a>

## Spawn

Per child `i` in `0..amount`, the direction is `parent_velocity_as_direction ? parent.vel * parent_velocity_direction_scale : angle + (relative_to_parent ? parent heading : 0) + r1 * spread` (degrees), and the velocity is `dir * speed + (speed_var_diagonal ? (1, 1) : dir) * speed_var * r2 + (inherit_velocity ? inherit_velocity_factor * parent.vel : 0)`, with r1, r2 in [-1, 1] (OLX `PhysicsLX56_Projectiles.cpp:562-640`, `olr-sim/src/spawn.rs`).

LX56 fixes four flags per context, so their defaults depend on where the spawn is (`mod-fields.md` §9; a file writes them only when they differ): `relative_to_parent` is true for a weapon's shot and false for an event spawn and a trail; `speed_var_diagonal` is true for a trail only; `random_rotation` and `inherit_velocity` are true for a shot only.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | integer | `1` | Children per spawn, at most `MAX_AMOUNT` (1000) (OLX `amount`). Default 1. |
| `speed` | integer | `0` | px/s, an integer; unitless when `parent_velocity_as_direction` (OLX `speed`). |
| `speed_var` | number | `0.0` | px/s, ± range (OLX `speed_var`). |
| `spread` | number | `0.0` | Degrees, ± half-width (360 = any direction) (OLX `spread`). |
| `relative_to_parent` | boolean | by context | Adds the parent's heading to `angle` (OLX `use_angle`). |
| `angle` | integer | `0` | Degrees (integer): 0 = +x (right), 90 = +y (down) (OLX `angle`). |
| `parent_velocity_as_direction` | boolean | `false` | Direction from the parent's velocity instead of an angle (OLX `use_parent_velocity_for_spread`; LX56 reads it for trails only). |
| `parent_velocity_direction_scale` | number | `0.3` | Unitless scale of that velocity (OLX `parent_vel_spread_factor`). Default 0.3. |
| `speed_var_diagonal` | boolean | by context | Speed variation along (1, 1) instead of the direction (OLX `use_special11_vec_for_speed_var`). |
| `random_rotation` | boolean | by context | A random start rotation for a rotating child (OLX `use_random_rot`). |
| `inherit_velocity` | boolean | by context | Adds `inherit_velocity_factor` × the parent's velocity. For a shot the parent is the worm, whose velocity counts as zero unless the game's `ProjRelativeVel` setting is on (OLX `add_parent_vel`). |
| `inherit_velocity_factor` | number | `1.0` | Unitless factor on the parent's velocity (OLX `parent_vel_factor`). Default 1.0. |
| `shared` | string (optional) | none | The id of a shared projectile (`projectiles/<id>.ron`). Exactly one of `shared` and `projectile` is set (OLX `proj`). |
| `projectile` | [Projectile](#projectile) (optional) | none | The spawned projectile, defined here (OLX `proj`); inline projectiles nest at most `MAX_INLINE_DEPTH` (32) deep. |

<a id="projectilelooksource"></a>

## ProjectileLookSource

A mod projectile's look.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `glow` | integer (optional) | none | How bright its sprite or pixels show whatever the darkness, percent, 0 to 100. Default none. |
| `light` | [LightSource](#lightsource) (optional) | none | A light following it; its clock is the projectile's age. Default none. |
| `end_flash` | [LightSource](#lightsource) (optional) | none | A light where it ended; its clock starts there, added to its explosion's light if it explodes. Default none. |
| `explosion` | [ExplosionLightSource](#explosionlightsource) (optional) | none | The light of every explosion it makes (its effects' `Explode`, its timer's, a `Bounce` explosion): replaces the engine's warm flash there. Default none: the mod's `look.explosion`, else the engine's. |
| `explosion_heat` | [ExplosionHeatSource](#explosionheatsource) (optional) | none | The heat every explosion it makes leaves in a level whose surface materials heat (the same explosions as `explosion`'s). Default none: the mod's `look.explosion_heat`, else the engine's. |
| `heat` | [ProjectileHeatSource](#projectileheatsource) (optional) | none | Heat it leaves around itself each tick it lives (flames, napalm, a hot slug), in a level whose surface materials heat. Default none. |

<a id="weaponstate"></a>

## WeaponState (enum)

OLX `WpnRestrictionState` (`include/CWpnRest.h:28-32`).

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Enabled` | — | `wpr_enabled` (0): selectable, and in bonuses. |
| `Bonus` | — | `wpr_bonus` (1): only in bonuses. |
| `Banned` | — | `wpr_banned` (2): nowhere. |

<a id="explosionlightsource"></a>

## ExplosionLightSource

An explosion's light: a glowing disc where it explodes, lighting the level while the explosion shows (its size × 25 ms). It replaces the engine's (warm, brighter and wider with the explosion's size). An explosion that is no projectile's (a bonus blown up, a beam) or an explosive trail keeps the engine's.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `colour` | [colour](#colour) | required | Opaque. |
| `intensity` | integer | required | The light at the explosion, percent, 0 to 1000. |
| `radius` | integer | required | The glowing disc's radius, world pixels, 1 to 16 (the engine's grow from 2 to 12 with the size). |
| `reach` | [ReachSource](#reachsource) | required | Where it fades to nothing: `Pixels`, 1 to 4096 (not `Unlimited`). |
| `animation` | [AnimationSource](#animationsource) (optional) | none | Default none: from full to nothing over the explosion's life, as the engine's. Given, its clock is the explosion's age in milliseconds, and the light still ends with the explosion. |
| `phase_ms` | integer (optional) | none | Shifts the animation's clock, milliseconds; only with an `animation`. Default none: a looping animation's phase comes from the explosion. |

<a id="explosionheatsource"></a>

## ExplosionHeatSource

An explosion's heat: how much it warms the rock and dirt around it, in a level whose surface materials heat (the level's materials decide what the heat does). Without one, every explosion leaves the engine's heat, which grows with its damage (a minigun hit warms the rock faintly, a Bazooka's rim glows, a Big Nuke's far more). Presentation only.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | integer | `100` | Percent of the engine's heat for the explosion, 0 (none) to 1000; an explosion never gives more than the engine's hottest (1000, white hot stone). Default 100. |
| `radius` | integer (optional) | none | How far it reaches, world pixels, 1 to 48; it falls off from the centre to there. Default none: the engine's for the explosion (past the crater it carves). |

<a id="weaponclass"></a>

## WeaponClass (enum)

OLX `Wpn_Class` (`WeaponDesc.h:25-34`); unused everywhere.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Automatic` | — | LX value 0 (the default). |
| `PowerGun` | — | LX value 1. |
| `Grenade` | — | LX value 3. |
| `Missile` | — | LX value 4. |
| `CloseRange` | — | LX value 5. |
| `Unknown` | integer | Any other LX value (2 and unnamed ones). |

<a id="colour"></a>

## colour

A colour in an authoring file: `"#rrggbb"` (opaque) or `"#rrggbbaa"` (alpha 00 transparent to ff opaque), hex digits read in any case. Written lowercase, without the alpha when opaque.

<a id="specialkind"></a>

## SpecialKind (enum)

OLX `Wpn_Special`.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Off` | — | OLX `SPC_NONE` (0): drains the charge, no thrust. |
| `Jetpack` | — | OLX `SPC_JETPACK` (1): thrust, see `Fire::Special::thrust`. |
| `Unknown` | integer | Any other value; behaves like `Off`. |

<a id="lightsource"></a>

## LightSource

A mod's light: a projectile's light or flash, a weapon's muzzle light. Play draws it as a glowing disc (plan 15c).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `colour` | [colour](#colour) | required | Opaque. |
| `intensity` | integer | required | The light at the source, percent, 0 to 1000. |
| `reach` | [ReachSource](#reachsource) | required | Where it fades to nothing. |
| `animation` | [AnimationSource](#animationsource) | `Steady` | Default `Steady`. |
| `phase_ms` | integer (optional) | none | Shifts the animation's clock, milliseconds; by default a looping animation's phase comes from the light's identity, so equal lights never pulse together. Default none. |

<a id="animation"></a>

## Animation

A projectile's frame animation (OLX `Animating`, `AnimRate`, `AnimType`).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fps` | number | `0.0` | Frames per second (OLX `rate`). |
| `mode` | [AnimMode](#animmode) | `Once` | What happens at the last frame. `Once` removes the projectile (OLX `AnimType`). |

<a id="projectileheatsource"></a>

## ProjectileHeatSource

The heat a projectile leaves where it is, each tick (10 ms) it lives; it falls off from its centre to `radius`. Presentation only.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | integer | required | The heat a tick gives stone at its centre, 1 to 100 (an explosion's is up to 1000: a Bazooka's about 300). |
| `radius` | integer | required | How far it reaches, world pixels, 1 to 16. |

<a id="reachsource"></a>

## ReachSource (enum)

How far a light reaches: it fades to nothing there.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Pixels` | integer | World pixels, 1 to 4096. |
| `Unlimited` | — | No fade (in a level, glow light reaches across the whole level). |

<a id="animationsource"></a>

## AnimationSource (enum)

How a light's intensity changes over time. Levels are percent of its intensity (0 to 1000), times milliseconds. The clock is the match's (a mod's light: the projectile's age, or the time since its flash began).

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Steady` | — | Constant. |
| `Pulse` | `period_ms`, `low`, `high`, `shape` | Between `low` and `high` over `period_ms` (1 to 600 000), starting at the midpoint and rising. |
| `Flicker` | `speed`, `depth` | A flame's unsteadiness: smooth noise, the same on every machine. |
| `Keys` | `keys`, `looped` | A hand-made curve, linear between keys. |

### `AnimationSource::Pulse`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period_ms` | integer | required | Milliseconds, 1 to 600 000. |
| `low` | integer | required | Percent, 0 to 1000. |
| `high` | integer | required | Percent, 0 to 1000. |
| `shape` | [PulseShape](#pulseshape) | `Sine` | The wave. Default `Sine`. |

### `AnimationSource::Flicker`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | integer | required | Changes a second, 1 to 1000. |
| `depth` | integer | required | How far it dims, percent, 0 to 100. |

### `AnimationSource::Keys`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keys` | list of [keysource](#keysource) | required | 1 to 64 keys, their times not decreasing. |
| `looped` | boolean | `false` | Repeats after the last key; otherwise the light ends there (a flash). Default false. |

<a id="animmode"></a>

## AnimMode (enum)

What an animation does at its last frame (OLX `Proj_AnimType`).

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Once` | — | `ANI_ONCE` (0): deletes the projectile at the last frame. |
| `Loop` | — | `ANI_LOOP` (1): back to frame 0. |
| `PingPong` | — | `ANI_PINGPONG` (2): reverses at either end. |
| `Unknown` | integer | An OLX animation type this format has no name for: nothing at the end. |

<a id="pulseshape"></a>

## PulseShape (enum)

The wave of a `Pulse`.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Sine` | — | Smooth. |
| `Triangle` | — | Linear up and down. |
| `Square` | — | `high` for the first half of the period, `low` for the second. |

<a id="keysource"></a>

## keysource

One key of a `Keys` animation, written `(at_ms, level)` or `(at_ms, level, "#rrggbb")`: milliseconds from the curve's start, the intensity in percent (0 to 1000), and the light's colour from this key on.
